mapper.select: SELECT TOTAL_ASSET_AMT AS totalAssetAmount, NO_LOAN_YN AS noLoanYn FROM USER_ASSET_SNAPSHOT WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} AND BASE_MONTH = (SELECT MAX(BASE_MONTH) FROM USER_INCOME_MONTH WHERE USER_ID = #{userId})

SELECT L.LOAN_ID AS loanId, L.LOAN_TYPE_CODE AS loanTypeCode, T.LOAN_TYPE_NAME AS loanTypeName, L.BALANCE_AMT AS balanceAmount, L.ANNUAL_RATE_PCT AS annualRatePct, L.RATE_TYPE_CODE AS rateTypeCode, L.REMAINING_MONTHS AS remainingMonths, L.MONTHLY_PAYMENT_AMT AS monthlyPaymentAmount FROM USER_LOAN L JOIN DIM_LOAN_TYPE T ON T.LOAN_TYPE_CODE = L.LOAN_TYPE_CODE WHERE L.USER_ID = #{userId} AND L.BASE_MONTH = (SELECT MAX(BASE_MONTH) FROM USER_INCOME_MONTH WHERE USER_ID = #{userId}) ORDER BY L.LOAN_ID

SELECT BILL_MONTH, PAYMENT_STATUS_CODE FROM USER_UTILITY_PAYMENT WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} AND SOURCE_CODE = 'IMPORTED' AND BILL_MONTH >= ( SELECT TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(MAX(BILL_MONTH), 'YYYY-MM'), -11), 'YYYY-MM') FROM USER_UTILITY_PAYMENT WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} AND SOURCE_CODE = 'IMPORTED') ORDER BY BILL_MONTH
